title: SpringBig Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: SpringBig Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 1, 2026 disclosing a new Executive Employment Agreement with CEO Jaret Christopher, formalizing a $450,000 annual base salary, 50% target bonus, and a restricted stock grant of 12,891,251 shares with accelerated vesting provisions upon qualifying terminations and Change in Control events.
key_points: SpringBig Holdings, Inc. entered into a 3-year Executive Employment Agreement with CEO Jaret Christopher effective April 1, 2026, with automatic 1-year renewals.
The agreement provides an annual base salary of $450,000 and a target annual cash bonus opportunity equal to 50% of base salary.

Mr. Christopher received a Restricted Stock Award of 12,891,251 shares, with approximately 8,320,939 shares vested on the Effective Date and remaining shares vesting in equal quarterly installments over approximately three years.
Severance provisions include 12 months of base salary continuation (outside Change in Control) or lump-sum payment of base plus target bonus (within 18 months of Change in Control).
The company is a cannabis technology platform headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida, with no securities listed on a national exchange.
